name: VETCO Clinics
description: Low-cost vaccinations, microchipping, and preventive care at Petco stores (by appointment)
fullDescription: Vetco Vaccination Clinics inside Petco stores provide low-cost preventive care for dogs and cats, including vaccines, testing, parasite prevention, and microchipping.
whatTheyOffer:
- Dog and cat vaccines (rabies, distemper/parvo, leptospirosis, bordetella, feline leukemia, and more)
- Puppy, kitten, and adult vaccine packages
- Microchipping
- Heartworm and other preventive testing
- Flea, tick, and heartworm prevention and deworming
- Located inside Petco stores; prices vary by location
howToGetIt:
1. Visit vetcoclinics.com to find a clinic at a Petco near you
2. Book an appointment online (vaccinations are by appointment only)
3. Bring your pet to the store at your appointment time
4. Pay at time of service
keywords: Vetco, Petco, vaccinations, microchip, heartworm test, flea, tick, affordable, pet shots, vaccine packages
